title: Recognition and remodelling of nucleosomes and hexasomes by the human INO80 complex
authors: Aggarwal P; Sharma M; Woike S; Kunert F; Moldt M; Hopfner K
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构解析人类INO80复合物与核小体及六聚体的结合与重塑机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构机理研究，但对象为染色质重塑复合物而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以结构生物学为主，缺乏AI或MD模拟，故评分为6。
abstract: The ATP-dependent INO80 chromatin remodeller slides and repositions nucleosomes to shape and maintain chromatin around gene regulatory elements and replication origins. Recent work uncovered capabilities of yeast and fungal INO80 to bind and slide hexasomes, but whether this is a universal feature is unknown. Here, we show that also human INO80 slides hexasomes as efficiently as H2A and H2A.Z nucleosomes. By determining a variety of structures of human INO80 bound to canonical and H2A.Z nucleosomes as well as hexasomes, we reveal a predominantly topological sensing of nucleosomal species with at least three positions depending on entry DNA unwrapping. INO80 spin-rotates around the wheel like nucleosomal core particle, with the position determined by the Snf2 ATPase that binds the tangentially protruding entry DNA at various degrees of unwrapping. Acidic patch binding by IES2 can differentiate between different nucleosomal species, is important for nucleosome but not hexasome sliding, and can sense unwrapped exit DNA. These findings provide structural and mechanistic insights into how human INO80 remodels diverse chromatin substrates in a topology driven manner.
abstract_zh: ATP依赖的INO80染色质重塑因子通过滑动和重新定位核小体，在基因调控元件和复制起点周围塑造并维持染色质。近期研究揭示了酵母和真菌INO80结合并滑动六聚体的能力，但这是否为普遍特性尚不清楚。在此，我们表明人类INO80也能以与H2A和H2A.Z核小体相当的效率滑动六聚体。通过解析人类INO80与经典及H2A.Z核小体以及六聚体结合的多种结构，我们揭示了一种主要基于拓扑感知的核小体种类识别机制，其至少存在三个取决于入口DNA解绕程度的位置。INO80围绕轮状核小体核心颗粒进行旋转，其位置由Snf2 ATPase决定，该酶以不同程度的解绕状态结合切向突出的入口DNA。IES2对酸性斑块的结合能够区分不同核小体种类，对核小体滑动至关重要但对六聚体滑动非必需，并能感知解绕的出口DNA。这些发现为人类INO80以拓扑驱动方式重塑多样染色质底物提供了结构和机制上的见解。
